title: Hotel apartment combo
content: In last night's dream, I was living in this hotel apartment combo. I had a rather nice room that was arranged just the way I wanted it to be, on one of the middle floors (I think floor 6 or 7, out of like 15) While rooms had their own bathrooms, there was also an area open to the public with a large shared bathroom. It had toilet stalls and a giant shower area. It was very clean inside. The lobby was like any hotel lobby, with a check in desk, a seating area near a fireplace, a breakfast area. (They had fresh breakfast all day! And it was open to the public just like the bathrooms.) Living areas were on separate floors from hotel areas. The halls on each floor seemed to go on forever, like I was looking down one hall and it just disappeared into fog because of how long it was. Walls had this vertical striped cream colored wallpaper on it. There were elevators but I don't remember ever getting on them or going down stairs, despite traveling between floors. Did I just teleport or something...? At one point, I noticed a very obvious fire hazard and decided not only to NOT fix the hazard, but set it up to be even more likely to cause a fire, and placed fuel around where the fire was likely to start. Sure enough a massive fire started and the building was damaged, but not destroyed. I'm not sure why I decided to do this, when I had it really good living there. Because I must always set things on fire in dreams I guess.
